testingFeedback: Testing caught five issues: a Rust or-pattern guard skipped stage-0 sutures, nearest-hazard selection stole forceps pulls, a sac's swell shared the laser charge meter, hub snapshots waited on a 60 Hz accumulator that never fired in an iframe, and ControlFlow::Poll cancelled the pending animation frame so an operation froze after one tick.
The most helpful checks were a skill-1.0 bot on every case from a fresh scene, and the hub harness traffic counters once the frame loop actually ticked.
The least helpful test was a temporary print probe that only dumped stuck hazards and was removed once the selection bug was fixed.
engineFeedback: The Game hook, recorded input, RenderFrame, headless egui, and the single-file packer.
Yes. A colon in the project path makes rustc fail joining LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and the demo frame path captures the camera, pause menu, and touch layer unless a game returns first.
The operative rules, the plate mesh, the ten-foot shell, the cue and music buses, and the hub shim.
Keeping a surgery scene off the demo boot panel, stats, guide, toasts, and the engine pause menu.

Added the surgery frame, surgeon input, and cue event; a view emit and camera shot; a product frame branch; audio buses and formants; session.js injection in the packer; and js-sys. On the web the surgery loop waits for animation frames, because Poll cancelled the pending frame. The hook alone cannot draw, play cues, or join a hub.
A first-class per-game frame path, so a new game does not have to outrun the demo loop.
promptFeedback: The tested camera, light, and palette numbers, and a hub shim that the harness had already accepted.
The deliverable folder name must contain a colon, which Cargo cannot use as its working directory.
Shipping one packed page that is the full game, a hub client, and a file:// WebGPU build.
Say at the start that the Cargo target directory cannot contain a colon.
